title: longfellow-vectors mdoc proof vector, v1
description: Sidecar for a proof blob under vectors/mdoc/proofs/. A vector holds the proof bytes and their provenance. The statement fields hold the public statement the bytes verify against. A vector whose source supplied no recoverable statement omits them and holds the bytes alone. Statement values are equal across proofs made from one session.

prover.description: Implementation that produced the proof bytes, by backend registry name, e.g. google-cpp.

circuit.description: Vector name of the circuit the proof was made with.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the sibling .proof file's bytes.

doctype.description: Mdoc doctype the proof is scoped to.

cbor_value.description: CBOR encoding of the attribute's value.

transcript.description: SessionTranscript bytes the proof is bound to.

issuer_public_key_x.description: Issuer (document signer) public key coordinate x.

issuer_public_key_y.description: Issuer (document signer) public key coordinate y.

timestamp.description: Verification time the proof was made with, as an RFC 3339 date-time carrying a UTC offset.

device_namespaces.description: Inner bytes of the tag-24 DeviceNameSpacesBytes; a verify input of some implementations, present when the source supplies it.

presentation.description: Vector name of the presentation the proof was made from.
